$description: BBDF typography roles. Source: BBDF_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (canonical copy lives at BB_DOCS/__ROBOT__WORK__/BBDF_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, NOT in this directory -- this folder holds the assets, that file holds the rules) §2. System font: Helvetica family (Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold, Helvetica-Oblique). Reportlab built-in; no external font loading required. Sizes are in points (pt) — canonical for PDF.

system.$description: System-wide font stack for PDF rendering. Helvetica is a reportlab built-in (always present server-side, never substituted). Arial is the Windows fallback.

office.$description: BINDING for documents opened in a Windows application -- .pptx, .docx, .xlsx and their Google conversions. Ben ruling 2026-08-18 (MANDY-267): "move the system to Arial for windows documents." Windows does not ship Helvetica, so a template naming it renders differently on every machine that opens it; Arial is metrically compatible, so no layout moves. PDFs keep Helvetica -- reportlab has it built in and does not substitute, so the two surfaces stay visually near-identical rather than diverging.

document-title.$description: Cover page + INDEXED title. Centered on cover below logo.

section-title-h1.$description: Section heading. ALWAYS followed by crimson-accent rule (1pt × content-width).

section-subtitle-h2.$description: Within-section subheading. No rule. Retained for back-compat with Round 1/2 templates; new INDEXED work uses role.section-title-h2 below (same metrics, scoped name).

section-title-h2.$description: INDEXED §4.3.1 second-level numbered section (1.1, 2.3, etc). Same metrics as section-subtitle-h2 -- alias under the section-title.* family so depth-forked styling reads naturally (h1 / h2 / h3) in templates.

section-title-h3.$description: INDEXED §4.3.1 third-level numbered section (1.1.1, 2.3.2). Smaller than H2; same bold weight. Used for table-breakdown sub-sub-sections inside a numbered subsection. Spec called this out as 'rarely used; flag if going deeper' -- this token exists so the depth is renderable when needed, not encouraging it.

description.$description: Italic intro text under a title — 6pt below the crimson rule.

body.$description: Default body paragraph. No first-line indent.

table-header.$description: Table header row — white text on navy fill, 6pt padding top/bottom.

table-body.$description: Table body cells — navy text, 4pt padding, alternating row fills.

footer.$description: Footer-band text — `Generated YYYY-MM-DD | CONFIDENTIAL` left, `benballdesign.com | Page N` right.

section-number.$description: INDEXED section numbers (1., 1.1, 1.1.1). Hanging-indent preserves title eye-line.

cross-reference.$description: INDEXED cross-refs -- `§2.3 (p. 7)` format. NEVER crimson. Standalone block-level form.

cross-reference-inline.$description: INDEXED §4.3.3 inline cross-ref appearing inside running body text -- `(see §1.2 Cash Position)`. Italic muted-gray; matches the block form's color/size but italicizes so it reads as a parenthetical aside in flowing prose. NEVER crimson.

toc-entry-title.$description: INDEXED §4.3.2 TOC entry section title -- left-aligned, takes the natural width of its content; the dot leader fills between this and the right-aligned page number.

toc-entry-page.$description: INDEXED §4.3.2 TOC entry page number -- right-aligned column, tabular-nums.

toc-leader.$description: INDEXED §4.3.2 TOC dot leader between section title and page number -- rule-gray 8pt regular. Implemented in HTML via a flexed dotted underline on a connector span; in reportlab via a DotLeader style on the Paragraph.

logo-name-primary-tracked.$description: Letter-spacing applied to row 1 ('BEN BALL') to match the right-edge of row 2 ('DESIGN & FABRICATION'). Calibrated target ~0.5em; tune to whatever achieves visual alignment.

logo-name-secondary.$description: Row 2 of name stack — 'DESIGN & FABRICATION'. Helvetica regular all-caps, footer-dark (NOT navy — contrast hierarchy against navy 'BEN BALL' above; re-uses the existing footer-dark token instead of minting a new color, keeping the palette at 11). +0.1em tracking, institutional feel.

logo-name-contact.$description: Rows 3–5 of name stack — email/web, mailing address, phone. Three rows, all Helvetica regular 7pt muted-gray. Pipe separators use single-space padding either side.

logo-name-stack-baseline.$description: Baseline-to-baseline gap between rows in the 5-row name stack. Whole stack vertically centered within 84pt header band.

header-doctype.$description: Header right-aligned doc-type label — INVESTOR UPDATE / PERSONAL UPDATE / APPLICATION FOR PAYMENT.
